# DubeAI

> DubeAI is a self-hosted GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) platform delivered with full source code. Customers deploy it in their own cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP, OpenShift, on-premises or air-gapped) and operate it with their own IT team. Perpetual licence instead of SaaS subscription — no vendor lock-in, data never leaves the customer's environment.

Not SaaS. Not consulting. A GRC platform built with AI.

## Modules

Access Control, Risk Management, Controls Management, Audit Management, Compliance, ISMS, Policy Management, Third-Party Risk, Business Continuity, Incident Management, Tax Compliance, AI Governance, Whistleblower.

Typical use: internal control systems (ICS/IKS), SOX 404 control testing, ISO 27001 ISMS, DORA, NIS2, MaRisk, EU AI Act governance.
